summary: 3D rooftop runner over an Istanbul covered bazaar, v2 with numbered gate splits, a reactive white Van cat and unique finales, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · İstanbul kapalı çarşısının kubbeleri üzerinde 3D çatı koşusu, v2'de numaralı kapı ara zamanları, tepki veren beyaz Van kedisi ve her seviyeye özel final, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Rooftop parkour: double jump, slide down domes, ride laundry lines and step up low ledges; first-encounter hints appear at the spot
Ten hand-built levels from layout strings: roofs, gaps, domes, sliding planks, breaking tiles, gusts and checkpoints
v2: numbered stone gate arches show a split against target, the result card lists them and the best split per gate is saved; a guild sign per level opens a notebook fact card
v2: the white Turkish Van cat that stole the ring reacts to your pace and hisses at gaps; every level ends with its own finale stretch
Three stars per level; the ?auto bot cleared 10/10 levels with 0 falls; 60 fps with 54-58 draw calls in headless Chromium

social.headline: Chase the ring thief across the domes of the bazaar · Yüzük hırsızı kediyi çarşının kubbeleri üzerinde kovala
